raw_record.question_text:
Read Beijing's 2009 urban construction land supply plan table (Table 1).

<image1>

Among the various types of land use, what is the reason that commercial service land is relatively small?
raw_record.standard_answer: Commercial service industries are highly concentrated

method.method_draft: First describe the table and note that 商业服务用地 is only 200公顷/3.5%, much less than basic infrastructure, residential, industrial/warehouse and other large categories. Then connect this small land share to urban geography: commercial service industries do not need large continuous land parcels because they are high-density, high-value activities concentrated in business centers. Therefore the reason is 商业服务业高度集聚.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：表1是“北京市2009年城市建设土地供应计划表”，列出用地类型、面积（公顷）和比重（%）。其中商业服务用地为200公顷，占3.5%；基础设施用地为2800公顷，占49.1%；工业仓储用地为800公顷，占14%；住宅商品房用地为700公顷，占12.3%；经济适用住房用地为600公顷，占10.5%；科教文卫体行政用地为400公顷，占7%。可见商业服务用地在各项用地中所占比例较小。再推理：商业服务业通常属于高密度、高地价、高集聚的城市功能，主要集中在商业中心、商务区等区位，不需要大面积连续土地，因此土地供应面积较少。
